description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Databricks builds data and AI infrastructure, including a unified platform for the data lifecycle. The Software Engineer will contribute to distributed data systems, working in areas such as query execution, storage, security, and resource management.
New Grad Software Engineer building distributed data systems through query compilation and execution, transaction coordination, and storage optimization

Responsibilities:
• Query compilation and optimization
• Distributed query execution and scheduling
• Vectorized execution engine
• Data security
• Resource management
• Transaction coordination
• Efficient storage structures (encodings, indexes)
• Automatic physical data optimization
• Data plane storage
• Storage management system

Requirements:
• You will graduate in Fall 2026 or Spring 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related subject
• You have implementation skills with a general purpose program language, such as Java, or C++
• You have knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and OOP principles
• A passion for database systems, storage systems, distributed systems, language design, or performance optimization
• You have experience managing end-to-end projects

Skills:
• You will graduate in Fall 2026 or Spring 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related subject
• You have implementation skills with a general purpose program language, such as Java, or C++
• You have knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and OOP principles
• A passion for database systems, storage systems, distributed systems, language design, or performance optimization
• You have experience managing end-to-end projects

Pay: $145K/yr - $155K/yr
